fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Periodic-Flow / Rotary Regenerator Matrix
description: Thermal-storage matrix discretized into N nodes, alternately heated by a hot blow and cooled by a cold blow. Per-node energy balances for matrix and gas integrated with scipy.solve_ivp to periodic steady state. Coppage-London / Kays-London reduced ε-NTU_o(Cr*) theory used as closed-form cross-check.
source: Kays & London (1984) Compact Heat Exchangers, ch.5 (periodic-flow regenerators); Shah & Sekulic (2003) Fundamentals of Heat Exchanger Design, ch.5; Coppage & London (1953) Trans. ASME 75:779.

unit.name: Rotary Air-to-Air Regenerator (balanced, symmetric)
unit.source: Kays & London (1984) ch.5; Shah & Sekulic (2003) ch.5.

C_h.note: Hot-stream heat capacity rate m_dot*cp (hot blow)

C_c.note: Cold-stream heat capacity rate m_dot*cp (cold blow)

rpm.note: Rotational speed of wheel; sets blow period P = 30/rpm s per stream

air_cp.note: Air specific heat at ~300 K, 1 atm (Cengel & Ghajar 2015, Table A-15)

air_rho.note: Air density at 25 C, 1 atm (Cengel & Ghajar 2015, Table A-15)
